usage: Use 「淺綠色」 as a noun for a light green colour. Example: 呢件衫係淺綠色。
It is common in everyday descriptions of clothes, objects, and rooms. Example: 我想要淺綠色嘅牆。
You can place it after a modifier like 「好」 or 「幾」 for a softer description. Example: 呢隻茶幾淺綠色。
It can also be used when choosing or comparing colours. Example: 你鍾意淺綠色定深綠色？
